title: v4.1.4 OpenClaw end-to-end agent smoke test
script: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge'; $so=Join-Path $root 'agent-smoke-051u.stdout.json';$se=Join-Path $root 'agent-smoke-051u.stderr.txt';Remove-Item $so,$se -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$p=Start-Process -FilePath 'openclaw.cmd' -ArgumentList @('agent','--session-key','3en-v414-smoke','--message','Reply with exactly OPENCLAW_BRIDGE_OK','--json','--timeout','180') -Wait -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardOutput $so -RedirectStandardError $se; if($p.ExitCode -ne 0){throw ('OPENCLAW_AGENT_TURN_FAILED code='+$p.ExitCode)}; $raw=Get-Content $so -Raw; try{$null=$raw|ConvertFrom-Json}catch{throw 'OPENCLAW_AGENT_JSON_INVALID'}; if($raw -notmatch 'OPENCLAW_BRIDGE_OK'){throw 'OPENCLAW_AGENT_MARKER_MISSING'}; Write-Output 'V414_051U_AGENT=PASS'
